component.name: SLRXFM
component.summary: Smech Labs Remastered Xandros File Manager

description.p: SLRXFM is a clean-room, from-scratch reimplementation of the behavior of XandrosFileManager, the proprietary file manager shipped with Xandros Desktop 1.0 (2002), part of a broader historical-preservation and software-recreation project for that distribution.

It provides a dual-pane style folder tree and file listing, with copy/cut/paste/delete/rename, move-to-trash/restore/empty-trash, symlink creation, and browsing of local, SMB, FTP, and WebDAV locations through one unified interface.
First Debian-packaging-focused development snapshot: real Qt6 GUI, real SMB/FTP/WebDAV backends, Debian packaging in progress.
